rationale: Choose the registered pocket family to test the scale-dependent pair-kernel signal through contact and repulsion settings without importing the original bound-ligand geometry. Set contact_weight to 0.25 as a restrained candidate and keep repulsion and native_rms_ratio at supplied baseline values; use a static time ramp because the evidence does not establish a stage-specific rule. The endpoint associations motivate a controlled comparison but do not establish that these updates cause higher pIC50. This family uses receptor-crop geometry without generated Steer or bound-ligand reward, and its distance field is not a physical affinity energy.
failure_modes: The compressed selected evidence may omit comparisons that change the apparent scale-dependent pattern.
Endpoint associations may not reproduce under steering and do not establish causal improvement; assess endpoint and survival separately.
The pocket distance field is an untyped geometric proxy and may reward geometries unrelated to affinity.
A zero time-ramp power removes stage-dependent weighting and may miss useful temporal behavior.
